title: festuca arundinacea f. baltica
intro: Festuca arundinacea f. baltica, commonly known as Baltic meadow-grass, is a variety of the perennial grass species Festuca arundinacea. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine, where it has been used to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Baltic meadow-grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory effects.
